verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships an official command-line tool, glitchtip-cli (Beta). Its documented non-UI commands fit CI pipelines: creating releases, recording deploys, uploading debug files, and injecting debug IDs and uploading source maps. The product also self-hosts via Docker and aims for Sentry API compatibility. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents CI or headless use, the only auth shown is an interactive-looking `login` command, and the CLI is labeled Beta. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage docs, non-interactive token/env-var auth for pipelines, stable (non-beta) CLI status, a published API spec (OpenAPI probes 404), independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
